Medium-wide eye-level shot on a 35mm lens, composed for 16:9. Scarlett (Image 1) VEGA strides toward the backward-moving camera through a narrow downtown apartment hallway, one hand holding an open coral lipstick tube and the other carrying a structured neutral canvas tote, her weight already driving forward and eyes fixed ahead before snapping the cap shut. Cream plaster walls, implied apartment doors, and a gray radiator shelf recede behind her toward the stairwell; her smartphone rests on the shelf in the background. Soft natural morning light fills the corridor evenly. Fresh, tactile, editorial social-first beauty campaign style, clean bright color, lifted shadows, crisp coral accent, subtle handheld energy.
